findings.title: Commit markers are checkbox items instead of plain `**Commit**:` lines
findings.description: All 17 commit markers in this file are written as checklist items (`- [ ] Commit: \`feat: ...\``, e.g. lines 112, 157, 187, 217, 264, 320, 508, 527), rather than plain `**Commit**: \`...\`` lines. This deviates from the repo's established convention — every other task file I checked (e.g. `144-tasks.utility-actions.md`, `128-tasks.review-transport-unification-provider-decoupling.md`) uses the plain non-checkbox `**Commit**:` form, which is what the review convention calls for ("plain lines, never checkboxes"). Any tooling that greps for `**Commit**:` to find tested commit points will find none here. The placement itself is correct (after impl+test pairs, not every task, not only at the end), so only the marker format needs fixing.

findings.title: Load test adds a time assertion the design deliberately omitted — consistent with review requirements
findings.description: The design's Special Considerations state "There is still no assertion on time in tests" and rely on walkthrough step 8 for wall-clock measurement. Task 22a introduces a hard 1.0 s assertion, a small addition beyond the design text, but it is appropriate: the review criteria require a load test when the slice restates an NFR, and the bound is described as generous for CI jitter. No action needed; noted only for awareness of the design/task difference.
